questions.question: Which cron expression runs a job at 09:30 every Monday to Friday?
questions.explanation: The fields are minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week. Minute 30, hour 9, any day and month, weekdays 1-5.

questions.question: When does `0 9 13 * 5` run?
options: Only on Fridays that fall on the 13th
At 09:00 on the 13th of every month and also every Friday
At 09:00 on the 5th of every month
questions.explanation: When both day of month and day of week are restricted, cron runs the job if either one matches.

questions.question: A script that calls `node` works in your terminal but fails under cron with "node: not found". What is the most likely cause?
options: Cron uses a minimal PATH and does not read ~/.bashrc, so node's directory is not on the PATH
The crontab file is missing execute permission
Cron runs jobs only as root
questions.explanation: Cron's environment is minimal, typically PATH=/usr/bin:/bin with /bin/sh. Set PATH at the top of the crontab or use absolute paths.

questions.question: Why is `crontab -r` dangerous?
options: It restarts the cron daemon and skips due jobs
It removes your entire crontab without asking for confirmation
It resets the system time zone
questions.explanation: -r deletes the whole crontab with no prompt, and it sits next to -e on the keyboard. Back up with crontab -l > file first.
